t: Pinning the Notebooks Folder: Solving Git's Embedded Repo Puzzle
s: This article details a developer's process of promoting the 'Notebooks/' folder to the root of their Pipulate project. It addresses the technical challenge of Git's handling of directories and the need to 'pin' an empty directory within a Git repository to ensure its persistent presence.
sub: Promoting Notebooks folder to project root
Git's handling of empty directories ('phantom' directories)
Using a dummy file to 'pin' a directory in Git
Refactoring project structure for AI assistants
